The following events took place in '''3636 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Vitiate re-emerges on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] following his [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|revival]], and ultimately consumes all life on the planet, just as he had on his homeworld of [[Nathema]] 1364 years earlier.<ref name="Ziost" />
*The [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] emerges from [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and [[Eternal Empire raids|attacks]] several [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
*Vitiate, in the guise of [[Valkorion]], is killed in a confrontation with the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] and [[Arcann]], who usurps the [[Eternal Throne]] and begins the [[Eternal Empire conquest]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
*[[Alliance Commander|The Outlander]] is frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
